open_points.subject: capture input provenance
open_points.text: The capture callable keeps the broad PortRef input contract. ... StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef continue through the existing fit, size and copy checks. / It copies its inputs, spooled files included, into the case
open_points.question: Must the supplied PortRef tuple exactly identify the inputs recorded on the captured NodeExecution, or may the caller substitute other readable values or files that fit the contract?
options: Require every supplied reference to match the captured NodeExecution's recorded input at that port
Ignore supplied references and derive all inputs from the NodeExecution
Allow any fitting readable references supplied by the caller
open_points.default_guess: Require an exact match to the captured NodeExecution's recorded inputs.

open_points.subject: capture validation order
open_points.text: It first resolves the executed implementation, then checks its contract version against the named version. ... Next it checks the complete input tuple for facts-only file references / These checks, in this order, come before the case is built
open_points.question: Where do A15's checks that the execution ran in the sandbox, did not succeed, and still has an available spool occur relative to implementation resolution, contract mismatch, and the FileFactsRef scan?
options: Run the new A04 sequence first, then A15's eligibility checks
Run A15's eligibility checks first, then the new A04 sequence
Interleave them according to a newly specified total order
open_points.default_guess: Resolve the source execution and implementation, check contract match, scan for FileFactsRef, then apply A15's remaining eligibility checks.

open_points.subject: unknown input references during capture
open_points.text: A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks / a contract mismatch is refused before input checks. Next it checks the complete input tuple for facts-only file references, before looking up any input value or spooled file.
open_points.question: If a capture request has a contract mismatch or a FileFactsRef and also directly names an unknown StoredValue or SpooledFile, does A16 require unknown_reference first, or does A04 require the mismatch/FileFactsRef refusal without looking up that reference?
options: A16 wins: resolve every directly named input record before A04's own checks
A04 is an explicit exception: implementation, contract mismatch, and FileFactsRef checks precede input-reference resolution
Only the executed implementation receives unknown-reference precedence; other unknown references are checked later
open_points.default_guess: Treat the changed A04 sequence as an explicit exception, so input-reference existence is checked only after contract and FileFactsRef checks.

open_points.subject: named contract version in capture
open_points.text: then checks its contract version against the named version. An unknown implementation remains unknown_reference; a contract mismatch is refused before input checks.
open_points.question: Must the named contract version be resolved as an existing ContractVersion, and what wins when it is unknown: unknown_reference or contract mismatch based only on unequal identifiers?
options: Resolve it and return unknown_reference if absent
Compare identifiers without resolving it and return contract mismatch
Resolve it only after the identifier matches the implementation's contract version
open_points.default_guess: Resolve the named contract version and return unknown_reference if it does not exist.

open_points.subject: FileFactsRef versus SpooledFilesRef
open_points.text: Any FileFactsRef, including an empty file list, is refused ... StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef continue through the existing fit, size and copy checks. / NodeExecution inputs and outputs are references ... to SpooledFiles by their facts
open_points.question: Which recorded file references are FileFactsRef and which are SpooledFilesRef, particularly the spooled-file facts stored in a NodeExecution, and what durable fields distinguish a readable spool reference from facts-only metadata?
options: NodeExecution coordinates that can resolve live spool bytes are SpooledFilesRef; digest/size/media-type-only records are FileFactsRef
Every file represented by facts in a trace is FileFactsRef and therefore cannot be captured
Classification depends on whether the bytes happen to remain available when capture is called
open_points.default_guess: Treat a reference carrying stable run/spool coordinates as SpooledFilesRef and digest/size/media-type-only metadata as FileFactsRef.
